correctness.rationale: Classifying adjacent deletions by an equality-edge path and separated deletions by their first unmatched surviving letter proves the local formula for all q>=2,n>=3. The pair-state transfer enumerator and extrema follow exactly. Three-local scores are 2-dependent; explicit gamma0 and gamma1, zero gamma2, and independent-block Lindeberg give exact mean/variance and fixed-alphabet Gaussian limit. Independent finite checker replay: 144555 direct word checks, 27 complete distributions and rational moment profiles. Finite checks are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The (2,3) localized channel is the smallest fixed two-deletion model in which skipped-middle deletions matter. The structural triple identity explains all overlaps, gives the full sphere-volume distribution at every length, reveals the sharp binary/nonbinary extremal split and supplies finite dispersion and asymptotic Gaussian fluctuations. These motivated exact channel invariants are not arbitrary numerical slices or routine recomputations of known code sizes.
